submissions_visibility.name: submissions_visibility
submissions_visibility.value: not "submissions"."listed" or ("submissions"."status"='approved' and "submissions"."deleted_at" is null and "submissions"."delete_marked_at" is null)

submissions_review.name: submissions_review
submissions_review.value: ("submissions"."status" in ('uploading','pending') and "submissions"."reviewed_at" is null) or ("submissions"."status" in ('approved','rejected') and "submissions"."reviewed_at" is not null and ("submissions"."status"<>'rejected' or length(trim("submissions"."reason")) between 1 and 500))
